sourceTitle: The Visions of England Lyrics on leading men and events in English History
description: "The Visions of England" by Francis Turner Palgrave is a collection of lyrical poems written in the late 19th century. This work captures pivotal moments and figures in English history through verse, aiming to reconcile poetic expression with historical truth.
